programmes.name: Diploma in Computing and Information Technology (DCIT)
programmes.entryRequirements: ACSEE with at least 1 principal pass and 1 subsidiary pass; OR Basic Technician Certificate (NTA Level 4) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or Electronic Engineering.
programmes.focus: Hardware, networking, programming, web, databases, server and CCNA-aligned practicals.
programmes.bestFor: Students who want a strong technical / software-development / network-engineering career path, or who plan to bridge to a CS/IT degree.
programmes.locations: UCC Headquarters at UDSM Mlimani Campus opposite NBC Bank, Dar es Salaam; UCC Dodoma Branch at Capital Compound, Mathias Street, Miyuji.

programmes.name: Diploma in Business Information Technology (DBIT)
programmes.entryRequirements: ACSEE with at least 1 principal pass and 1 subsidiary pass; OR Basic Technician Certificate (NTA Level 4) in Business Administration, Accountancy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Technology, or Computer Engineering.
programmes.focus: Business + IT (accounting packages, e-business, web services, business law, entrepreneurship, management).
programmes.bestFor: Students who want to work at the intersection of business and IT — business analyst, IT sales, e-commerce, ERP/SAP, or run their own IT business.
programmes.locations: UCC Headquarters at UDSM Mlimani Campus opposite NBC Bank, Dar es Salaam; UCC Dodoma Branch at Capital Compound, Mathias Street, Miyuji.

programmes.name: Certificate in Computing and Information Technology (CCIT)
programmes.entryRequirements: Certificate of Secondary Education (CSEE) with at least 4 passes in non-religious subjects; OR National Vocational Training Award (NVTA) Level III / Trade Test Grade I from a recognized institution.
programmes.focus: Foundational computing and information technology skills.
programmes.bestFor: Students seeking a quick entry-level IT qualification.
programmes.locations: UCC Headquarters at UDSM Mlimani Campus opposite NBC Bank, Dar es Salaam; UCC Dodoma Branch at Capital Compound, Mathias Street, Miyuji.

programmes.name: Certificate in Business Information Technology (CBIT)
programmes.entryRequirements: Certificate of Secondary Education (CSEE) with at least 4 passes in non-religious subjects; OR National Vocational Training Award (NVTA) Level III / Trade Test Grade I from a recognized institution.
programmes.bestFor: Students seeking a quick entry-level business IT qualification.
programmes.locations: UCC Headquarters at UDSM Mlimani Campus opposite NBC Bank, Dar es Salaam; UCC Dodoma Branch at Capital Compound, Mathias Street, Miyuji.
